expectedIssues: Section title shows the raw translation key home_feed.popular_title instead of translated text
reportedIssues: The section heading below 'Fastest near you' shows the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable label such as 'Popular near you'.

The favorite (heart) buttons on the two popular restaurant cards use inconsistent styling — the first is a white circle with a dark outline heart, the second is a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol…') is cut off at the right edge with its title clipped and no visual affordance that the list scrolls.
The second popular restaurant card is clipped by the bottom navigation bar with no visible name, rating or metadata, making the feed appear cut off.

Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, heart favorite buttons, search magnifier) have no visible text labels; if accessible names are missing they will be unusable with screen readers.
